cohort: A total of 131 neonates with perinatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) undergoing therapeutic hypothermia (TH) between January 2010 and December 2020.
finding: Sedation-analgesia (SA) during therapeutic hypothermia for perinatal HIE did not alter early MRI severity scores, but was associated with lower survival to discharge, which may be related to illness severity rather than SA use alone.
